snippet.title: Goal! (NES) - Jaleco, Oct 1989 | NESguide 240p
snippet.description:
Goal! was released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console in October 1989. All audio/visual elements copyright 1989, Jaleco. Music composed by ?

https://nesguide.com/games/goal/

No save-states or other cheats were used in this video. It was captured from an original NES console from the red and yellow RCA a/v ports on the side.

-----------

ABOUT GOAL! (NES)

The game has four modes: World Cup, Tournament, Shoot Competition, and Vs. Mode. The object of the game is the same as in real football; one team must score more goals than the other to win. When playing World Cup or Tournament mode with two players, the players can either play on the same team or against each other.

AKA: Moero!! Pro Soccer
